title: Wireface 2D settings
description: A 2D face's settings, for createFace2d(canvas, { config }) or face.set(). Every key is optional; anything left out keeps its default. "auto" follows the character's art style.

character.description: A character's id from assets/characters/characters.json, or null.

framing.description: contain: all of the picture; cover: fill the canvas; face: close on the face.

depth.description: How far the head turns in 3D: 0 (flat) to 1, or auto.

edge_pin.description: How firmly the face's outline holds to the picture behind it.

feather.description: How soft the face's edge is, in eye-widths.

shading.description: lit: 3D lighting as the head turns; flat: none (drawings); auto: by art style.

smoothing.description: smooth, or pixel (no blur, for pixel art); auto: by art style.

teeth_mode.description: rendered teeth, a picture of teeth (asset), none, or auto (by art style).

teeth_style.description: Which teeth picture, in asset mode.

mouth_color.description: The inside of the mouth: #rrggbb, or auto (from the character's lips).

follow_mouse.description: The head turns a little towards the pointer.

expressiveness.description: How strongly expressions and gestures show.

show_mesh.description: Draw the fitted mesh over the face.
